acquisition method: data-dependent analysis (DDA) selection of the 10 most intense ions for fragmentation
alkylation reagent: sequentially alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min in the dark at RT.
alkylation concentration: sequentially alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min in the dark at RT.
cleavage agent: Proteins were firstly incubated with Lys-C at a 1:50 (w/w) ratio (enzyme:protein) for 5 h and then trypsin was then added at a 1:50 (w/w) ratio
collision energy: fragmentation in the HCD collision cell with an NCE of 25
enrichment method: An Fe(III)-NTA-IMAC-based enrichment workflow was applied to a dilution series of MM tissue lysates.
fractionation method: high pH reversed-phase peptide pre-fractionation of the MM2 sample was also performed on the AssayMAP Bravo platform.
fragmentation method: fragmentation in the HCD collision cell with an NCE of 25
instrument: coupled on-line to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA) or on an Ultimate 3000 HPLC coupled to a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer
labeling: For statistical analyses, label-free quantification (LFQ) data was log2-transformed
reduction reagent: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at room temperature (RT)
reduction concentration: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at room temperature (RT)
